Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 8. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification.

(ii) Cause physical damage to the user or equipment during the exploitation. (iii) Tap information resident or transient in the equipment/network. (b) The firm will be considered to be in breach of the procurement contract, in case physical damage, loss of information or infringements related to copyright and Intellectual Property Right (IPRs) are caused due to activation of any such malicious code in embedded software. 11. It will be mandatory for the Bidd ers to indicate their bank account numbers and other relevant e-payment details so t hat payments could be made through ECS/NEFT mechanism instead of payment thro ugh cheques, wherever feasible. The payment will be made a s per the following items, on production of the requisite documents. 2. Advance Payments. No advance payment(s) will be made. 2.1. Payment Terms. The rental amount will be paid on quarterly/ Half Year ly basis whichever applicable from the date of hiring depending upon the appr oval from higher authorities. Bills for the same will be provided in advance for t imely payment. 2.2. The circuits will be under observation for performance verification for a period of 15 days after commissioning. If SLA requirements are not met durin g the trial period, the contract will be deemed as cancelled and the cost of the trial period will be entirely borne by the vendor. 3. Important Hiring Terms. 3.1. As Military Communication links for all military stations will be ultimate ly established on Military owned OFC based network for Spectrum (NFS) links. Thus, these one 10 Mbps communication links will be short closed on functioni ng of the NFS communication. 3.2. The duration of hiring of these one 10 Mbps communication links will b e for One (01) year and every y ear may be renewed as per same terms and c onditions. 4. Product Support. 4.1. The seller agrees to provide product support for the stores, assemblies /sub assembles fitment and consumables, firmware from other agencies/Manuf acture by the seller for a minimum period of year including 0 1(one) years of w arranty period after the delivery of equipment over after said mandatory perio d the production line so as to enable a lifetime buy of all spares and firmware

before closer of the said production line . This however shall not restrict the bu yer from directly sourcing sub-equipment/ sub assembly and spares from their respective OEMs/Sub-vendors on completion of warranty. In case the sub equip ment/sub assem bled/parts require tuning/ collaboration/integration by the sell er prior to replacement the same is to be un dertaken by the seller at responsi ble cost as mutually agreed between Buyer and Seller. 4.2. In the event of any obsolescence during the above mentioned period o f product support in respect of any component or subsystem. Mutual consultati on between the seller and buyer will be undertaken to arrive at an acceptable solution including additional cost, if any. 5. Fall clause. The following Fall clause will form part of the Supply Order pl aced on successful Bidder:- 5.1. The price charged for the circuits rented under the Supply Order by th e Seller shall in no event exceed the lowest prices at which the Seller rents the circuit or offer to rent the circuit to any persons/Organization including the pur chaser or any department of the Central government or any Department of sta te government or any statutory undertaking the central or state government a s the case may be during the period till performance of all supply Orders place d during the currency of the rate Supply Order is completed. 5.2. If at any time, during the said period the Seller reduces the rental pric e or offer to rent to any persons/ Organization including the Buyer or any Deptt , of central Govt. or any Department of the State Government or any Statutory undertaking of the Central or state Government as the case may be at a price l ower than the price chargeable under the contract, the seller shall forthwith no tify such reduction or sale or offer of sale to the purchaser and the price payabl e under the Supply Order for the circuits of such reduction of sale or offer of th e sale shall stand correspondingly reduced. 5.3. The Seller shall furnish the following certificate to the Paying Authority along with each bill for payment for supplies made against the Supply Order – “We certify that there has been no reduction in sale price of the stores/ service s of description identical to the stores/ services supplied to the Government un der the Supply Order herein and such stores/ services have not been offered/s old by me/us to any person/recognize d including the purchaser or any depart ment of Central Government or any Department of a state Government or any Statutory Undertaking of the Central or state Government as the case may be up to the date of bill/the date of completion of supplies against all supply order s placed during the currency of the Supply Or der at price lower than the price charged to the government under the Supply Order except for quantity of stor es categories. 6. Liquidated Damages. In the event of the Seller’s failure to supply the sto res/goods or any installment thereof, or failure to perform services, conduct trials, ins tallation of equipment, training and MET, or any incidental works/services as specifie d in this contract, the buyer shall, without prejudice to any other remedy for breach o f contract, be entitled to recover from the seller Liquidated damages at the rate of 0. 5% of the total price (including elements of GST, freight/transportation and any appli cable variations such as PVC/E RV) of the delayed/undelivered stores or services for e ach week or part thereof of delay. The total LD shall not exceed 5% of the total price of the stores / services. In case of inordinate delay i.e delay exceeding on e-fourth (2 5%) of the total delivery period, the maximum LD may be increase to 10% of the tota l price delayed stores/services supplied with delay. Any extension of the delivery peri od (DP) granted on account of delays attributable to the buyer or due to force mejeur

e shall be duly factored in to the delivery schedule an d LD shall not levied for such e xtended periods. The buyer may at its discretion withhold payment of the delayed po rtion until completion and may deduct the applicable LD from payments due to the S eller. 7. Risk & Expense clause:- 7.1. Should the stores/ services or any installment thereof not be delivered within the time or times specified in the Supply Order documents, or if defectiv e delivery is made in respect of the stores or any installment thereof, the Buye r shall after granting the Seller 45 days to cure the breach, be at liberty, witho ut prejudice to the right to recover liquidated damages as a remedy for breach of contract, to declare the Supply Or der as cancelled either wholly or to the ex tent of such default. 7.2. Should the stores or any installment thereof not perform in accordance with the specifications / parameters provided by the SELLER during the check proof tests to be done in the BUYER’s country, the BUYER shall be at liberty, wi thout prejudice to any other remedies for breach of contract, to cancel the Sup ply Order wholly or to the extent of such default. 7.3. In case of a material breach that was not remedied within 45 days, the BUYER shall, having given the right of first refusal to the SELLER be at liberty t o purchase, manufacture, or procure from any other source as he thinks fit, ot her stores of the same or similar description to make good: 7.3.1. Such default. 7.3.2. In the event of the Supply Order being wholly determined the ba lance of the stores remaining to be delivered there under. 7.4. Any excess of the purchase price, cost of manufacturer, or value of an y stores procured from any other supplier as the case may be, over the Supply Order price appropriate to such default or balance shall be re coverable from t he SELLER. 8. Termination of Contract. The Buyer shall have the right to terminate th is Supply Order in part or in full in any of the following cases:- 8.1. The installation of the circuit is delayed for more than 02 months. 8.2. The quality of service is not as per SLA. 8.3. The Buyer has noticed that the Seller has utilized the services of any In dian/Foreign agent in getting this Supply Order and paid any commission to su ch individual/company etc. 9. Transfer and Sub-letting. The Seller has no right to give, bargain, sell, a ssign or sublet or other wise dispose of the Supply Order or any part thereof, a s well as to give or to let a third party take benefit or adv antage of the presen t Supply Order or any part thereof. 10. Refer Gov of Ministry of Finance letter No F No 1-1/2019/su-(i) MoD New Delhi dated 12 oct 2020 and Ministry of Finance No F N3 (74) E-coord/2019 dat ed 07 July 2022 as per Govt Order only PSUs/CPSEs providing Telecom services Provider can be participated. 11. d financial statement. SERVICE LEVEL AGREEMENT (SLA) 1. Over view : This Agreement, hereinafter called the Service Level Agreeme nt (SLA) is made on the ____ _day of 2026(year) to be effective between ____________ (hereinafter called Seller) of the One Part and 119 (I) Inf Bde Gp Sig Coy and register ed office at ________ (herein after called Purchaser). This SLA is reference with e-tend er for hiring of 10 Mbps Media connectivity on OFC between Pithoragarh to Balanti Fa rm (Point t o Point). 2. Contract Period : The terms and conditions agreed upon below are vali d from (01) one year the date a nd time of commissioning after final Acceptance Test Procedure (ATP). This required for the fine-tuning an d optimization of the Network. 3. Terms. The terms and conditions agreed upon below are valid from t he date and time of commissioning. This required for the fine-tuning and optimization of the Network. 4. Scope. 4.1. The agreement covers all of the following under its scope. :- 4.1.1. The PURCHASER and SELLER. 4.1.2. Entire project and adherence to the agreed upon Statement of Work. This mainly include:- 4.1.2.1. Long Distance Leased Lines from eNode A to eNod e B. 4.1.2.2. Network modems, interface converters and neces sary cabling within the Pt to Pt network. 4.1.2.3. Constant monitoring of the network. (ad) Power s ystem to ensure 100% network availability. 4.1.3. Parameters to evaluate the SLA achievement. 4.1.4. The technical Details of the 10 Mbps media is given at Annexur e I. 4.2. The scope will not include the following:- 4.2.1. Other networking equipment such as switches in LAN and other LAN Component last mile connectivity. 4.2.2. Applications, Server, Desktop or computing related infrastructur e. 5. Confidentiality. All the contents and parameters of this document mu st remain strictly confidential and must not be re-distributed without prior authorizati on from SELLER. 6. Network (Link) Availability (in %) 6.1. Network Availability. Network availability will be 99.9%. Under mention ed factors will not be accounted as down time for calculation of network availa bility:- 6.1.1. Down time due to force majeure.

6.1.2. Down time due to factors associated with failure of PURCHASER' s equipment. 6.2. Required availability (End to End connectivity of each link at PURCHAS ER's Premises. 6.3. If the PURCHASER is not satisfied with the level of service provided by the SELLER he can choose to terminate the contract by giving a three month n otice and reimburse the balance part of the payment or not renew it in the foll owing year. 6.4. The PURCHASER will give a telephonic/email/written complaint to the S ELLER if the link outage time is beyond acceptable limits. The SELLER should ju stify the PURCHASER’s complaint within a period of 48 hours. 6.5. If the incidence of network availability does not improve after three wri tten warnings, the PURCHASER c an terminate the contract forthwith and claim balance amount from disconnection date to contract termination date. An inter est rate of 12% per month will be levied on outstanding amount after fifteen d ays of issue of notice for termination. 7. Determination of Fault Duration:- 7.1. The Purchaser shall provide all necessary assistance and access to its fa cilities for preventive and corrective maintenance to Seller staff all the time. 7.2. In addition to the above following shall be excluded from fault duration :- 7.2.1. Unavailability of circuit due to power failure at Purchaser end. 7.2.2. Unavailability of circuit due to mishandling of equipment (NTU) or any cable attached to such equipment at Purchaser end. 7.2.3. Unavailability of circuit due to equipment. 7.2.4. Unavailability of circuit due to force majure. 8. Procedure of Fault Booking :- 8.1. Purchaser shall abide by the prescribed fault booking procedure of Sell er. Where the Purchaser is unable to find a Seller representative on the numbe r assigned above the fault can be booked on ‘e.g 05962-258 293’ which will wo rk as network (to the extent provided by the system) shall be taken as referen ce in situation where there is ambiguity about the timing and nature of fault. 8.2. A fault docket number shall be provided to the Purchaser from Seller on booking of fault. 9. Restoration of Faults:- 9.1. On receipt of complaints, Seller shall make its best efforts to localize t he fault and restore the same at the earliest. The Purchaser shall provide all ne cessary support for enabling testing of the circuit at any hours of the day. 9.2. It will be responsibility of Seller to show proper working of circuit from eNode A to eNode B basis through use of test instrument by sending test data while at the same time keeping the bit error rate within limits. Once circuit is b rought to right condition through such tests and the data transfer by Purchaser equipment to take necessary action at this end. The downtime will end as on a s Seller staff is able to show end to end data transfer using test instruments. 9.3. Restoration of Faults. On receipt of complaint, Seller shall attend to the

fault on the same day and resto re the circuit with immediate effect. 10. Service Level:- SELLER will ensure that the usage rights of the Bandw idth granted to purchaser will be available under the condition on a yearly basis in ac cordance with the schedule below except for Force Majeure Events, reasons attributa ble to the PURCHASER or reasons provided in this Agreement. The service level stand ards will be as follows:- 10.1. Uptime of each links will be 24 x 7. 10.2. A schedule maintenance announced 7 days in advance, for 2 hours in each quarter, will not be counted towards downtime. The working hours and d ays can be increased / decreased by the PURCHASER with a o ne day notice. ( Total duration of down time for maintenance in a year will be 8 hours only excl uding down time due to force majeure). 10.3. Throughput and CIR is to be 10 MBPS and periodically the network sys tem integrator has to prove this to the PURCHASER on monthly basis. 10.4. Value of Each Hour Service:- 10.4.1. Total Service hour per year = 365 days x 24 hrs = 8760 hrs. 10.4.2. Addl outage permitted for maint @ 2 hrs/ quarter = 2 x 4 = 8 hours. 10.4.3. Outage permitted under SLA (0.10%) = 8760hrs - 8hrs= 8752hrs = (8752 x 0.10)/100 (99.5% serviceability) = 8.75hrs = 9hrs. 10.4.4. Permissible limit of outage per year = 9 + 8 = 17 hrs. 10.4.5. Total hrs of serviceability per year to be ensured per ye ar = 8760 (-) 17 = 8743hrs. 10.4.6. Value of every hrs of service = Y= X/8743hrs. 10.4.7. Is the hiring rate of the 10 Mbps circuit as per Supply Or der and Y is X/8743). 10.5. Penalty for Not Providing 99.5% Service. 10.5.1. SELLER will provide 99.5% of uptime for 8743 hours in a year. 10.5.2. Failure beyond permissible limit of 17 hours in a year wil l attract a penalty of Rs. 1.5 Y (1.5 times of Y) per hour and the same will be deducted from the outstanding payment due to the SELLER by PU RCHASER. 10.5.3. When the PURCHASER intimates the SELLER about the f ailure of a circuit, PURCHASER support / service centre of the SELLER will acknowledge the booking of faulty circuit by a unique no along with date and time. Each link will have an identification No specified in SLA. Link N o will be given at the time of issue of supply order. 10.5.4. Once the circuit is restored in all respects, SELLER will in timate the PURCHASER about the restoration and PURCHASER will recor d it with a unique follow up number along with date and time. 10.5.5. Outage circuits will be clearly documented by both the p arties as per Annx II.

10.5.6. The SELLER will send a monthly media outage time to th e PURCHASER indicating the outage time during the month. 10.5.7. Router support and upgrades as and when available will be provided by SELLER if applicable. 10.5.8. The PURCHASER will give a written complaint to the SEL LER if the link outage time is beyond acceptable limits. The SELLER shou ld justify the PURCHASERS complaint within a period of 48 hours. 10.5.9. If the incidence of network availability does not improve after three written warnings, the PURCHASER c an terminate date. An in terest rate of 12% per month will be levied on outstanding amount after fifteen days of issue of notice for termination. 11. Force Majeure. 11.1. No failure, delay or omission by either Party to fulfil any of its obligatio ns under this Agreement (other than the obligations to make payments when d ue) shall give rise to any claim against such party or be declared to be a breac h of this Agreement if any to the extent such failure, delay or omission arises fr om the ( Force Majeure) event not within the reasonable control and at the inst ance of such Party. Events of force majeure shall be:- 11.1.1. Blockade, revolution, riot, bombs, religious strife or ci vil commotion. 11.1.2. Strikes, lock-outs or other industrial action (other that th ose involving Primarily Party’s own employees or any of the SELLERS, su b-SELLERs etc., directly associated with the provision of Services under t his agreement). 11.1.3. Act of war (whether declared or undeclared), invasion, a rmed conflict or act of foreign army, blockade, embargo, revolution, insu rrection, terrorist or military action, politically motivated sabotage. 11.1.4. A decision or the order of a court or tribunal which has t he effect of restraining or delaying the provision of Services. 11.1.5. Explosions, accident, breakage of facilities, plant or equi pment, structural collapse, fire chemical or radioactive contamination (o ther than resulting from an act of war, terrorism or sabotage), caused by a person not being the affected Party or one of its SELLERs or sub-SELLE Rs, sub-lessees or any other agencies of the affected Party or any of thei r respective employees, and not being due to inherent defects of the aff ected facility or the failure to property operate the affected facility. 11.1.6. Fire, lightening, earthquake, tempest, cyclone, hurrican e, whirlwind, flood, landslide or any such natural disaster. 11.1.7. Epidemic or plague. 11.1.8. Any event or circumstance of a nature analogous to any of the above or any natural disaster. 12. Procedure for Calling Force Majeure:- 12.1. The affected Party shall give notice to the Party of the Force Majeure e vents as soon as is reasonably practicable, but not later than fifteen (15) Days after the date on which the affected party knew or should reasonably have kno wn of the commencement of Force Majeure Event.

12.2. Notice shall specify. 12.2.1. The nature of such Force Majeure Event. 12.2.2. The date and time when the affected party was materiall y and adversely affected by the Force Majeure Event. 12.2.3. The material adverse effect of such Force Majeure Event on the affected party. 12.2.4. The measures which the affected party has taken or pro poses to take, to alleviate the impact of those Force Majeure Events and / or mitigate the damage. 12.2.5. An estimate of the period of time that the affected party shall be unable to perform its obligations and / or continue to be materi ally adversely affected by the Force Majeure Event. 12.2.6. Any other relevant information as may be necessary. 13. Governing Laws. This agreement shall be covered and construed in acc ordance with Laws of India including without limitation, the relevant Central and Stat e Acts and Rules, Regulations and Notifications is sued and amended there under fro m time to time. .
